description.value: Urban Grocer is a neighbourhood grocery store situated at The Junction of Oak Bay Avenue and Fort Street in Victoria, run by people with over 50 years of experience in the Vancouver Island and Gulf Islands grocery trade. The store emphasises fresh and organic produce, operates an in-house deli, and carries a curated selection of local Vancouver Island products under the Island Good brand. It is a convenient resupply stop for cyclists riding the Oak Bay and Fort Street corridors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Urban Grocer is an active neighbourhood grocery store at 1625 Fort Street, Victoria BC, with a live weekly flyer dated May 22–28 2026 and an active hiring page. The phone number (778-265-0934) and email (community@urban-grocer.ca) in the website footer match OSM tags exactly. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null; basic groceries is confirmed by explicit website language.
